name: Injured Deer
description: You discover an injured deer nearby.

name: Deer Sighting
description: A deer watches you from a distance before bounding away.

name: Bear Encounter
description: A black bear appears on the path ahead, blocking your way.

name: Snake in the Grass
description: Something rustles in the tall grass. A snake is nearby.

name: Fish Jump
description: Fish break the surface nearby. This looks like a good place to fish.

name: Rockslide
description: Loose stones clatter down the slope toward you.

name: Slippery Rocks
description: Wet stones along the bank look unstable underfoot.

name: Storm on the Water
description: Wind picks up over the lake and rain starts to lash the shore.

name: Bat Colony
description: A cluster of bats stirs in the dark of the cave.

name: Abandoned Supplies
description: Someone left a small cache of supplies tucked under a rock.

name: Rich Foraging Patch
description: You stumble onto a dense patch of berries and useful plants.

name: Clear View from the Ridge
description: From the trail you can see several other areas of the wilderness.
